items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Yeah, he was a good, he was a very wonderful piano player. I finally think his last name was Robert, Louis Robertson.

ctx.x: I didn't really know about him.

Yeah, he was a good, he was a very wonderful piano player. I finally think his last name was Robert, Louis Robertson. Everybody called him Big Eye Louis. He was a good piano player. Another piano player was very good in his younger days, in his old days, naturally he kind of slowed up a little bit. But that was his son, his trumpet player Newman. Newman. Newman? Yeah. See the trumpet player Newman, Newman was around there, he played with Camp Basie.
